note: Contract for deploy/bootstrap-secrets.sh. The script declares the same rows in bash; keep both lists in sync (a unit test asserts every name here appears there). The installer writes env files only - never the application database.

secrets.name: SECRETS_KEYS
secrets.note: Master keyring for encrypted DB credentials. Copy it to the offline password manager; it must not be lost.

secrets.name: ADMIN_SETUP_TOKEN
secrets.note: One-time bootstrap. /admin/setup refuses a second use; remove the value after setup.

secrets.name: RESTIC_PASSWORD
secrets.note: Data-repository password. The offline copy is the only recovery path.

secrets.name: RESTIC_CONFIG_PASSWORD
secrets.note: Config-repository password. Must differ from RESTIC_PASSWORD.
